scope: Unbounded role identities with abstract original native attribute/membership predicates. Both session and effective identities must satisfy the selected exclusion. Stable original role sources preserve that exclusion; snapshot-only admission permits later privilege changes and says nothing about privileged definer paths.
limitations: No PostgreSQL pg_has_role membership-closure, native catalog or SQL/Python refinement proof
Role/source lifetime and reachable routine/ACL closure remain unqualified
No authenticated caller/issuer, full authority admission or protected final release proof
